reasoning: Only Spaanschen Brabander has an English translation (Brumble 1982, ACMRS Vol. 11 — one play). The other six plays in the 1617 collected volume (Moortje, Griane, Rodd'rick, Lucelle, two farces) have never been translated; Dutch Courtesan Project scholars note they must translate Moortje quotations themselves. Our item is the first complete English rendering of the collected plays.
